Warcry.name: Warcry
Warcry.description: A battle cry that sharpens focus and surges adrenaline.

Piercing Thrust.name: Piercing Thrust
Piercing Thrust.description: A precise thrust aimed at a weak point in the target's guard.

Void Scream.name: Void Scream
Void Scream.description: An otherworldly shriek that bypasses physical defences and scrambles the senses.

Abyssal Surge.name: Abyssal Surge
Abyssal Surge.description: Releases a wave of abyssal energy that corrupts everything it touches.

Chain Lightning.name: Chain Lightning
Chain Lightning.description: Lightning arcs between all targets, leaving each one rattled and exposed.

Cyclone.name: Cyclone
Cyclone.description: Spin in a violent cyclone, battering all enemies and distrupting their balance.

Divine Judgement.name: Divine Judgement
Divine Judgement.description: Channels divine wrath into a single condemning blow.

Tempest.name: Tempest
Tempest.description: A sustained tempest that overwhelms all opponents with relentless force.

Overwhelm.name: Overwhelm
Overwhelm.description: A relentless barrage of blows that breaks down the target's ability to fight back.

Crushing Blow.name: Crushing Blow
Crushing Blow.description: A brutal overhead swing with no regard for finesse.

Lunge.name: Lunge
Lunge.description: A sudden forward strike with full body weight behind it.

Bash.name: Bash
Bash.description: A heavy blow with a chance to stun.

Sunder.name: Sunder
Sunder.description: A two-handed blow aimed at cracking through armour and guard alike.

Constrict.name: Constrict
Constrict.description: Grabs and crushes the target, potentially stunning and slowing them.

Tear Apart.name: Tear Apart
Tear Apart.description: A savage, all-out assault that shreds defences and leaves devastation in its wake.

Thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
Thunderclap.description: An explosive burst of thunder that shakes the battlefield and stuns the unprepared.

Colossal Slam.name: Colossal Slam
Colossal Slam.description: Slams the ground with enough force to stagger everyone nearby.

Rend.name: Rend
Rend.description: A vicious slash that opens a bleeding wound.

Venomous Bite.name: Venomous Bite
Venomous Bite.description: A bite that injects slow-acting venom into the bloodstream.

Smoulder.name: Smoulder
Smoulder.description: Scorching heat applied to a single target, leaving lingering flames.

Ravaging Strike.name: Ravaging Strike
Ravaging Strike.description: A frenzied assault that leaves the target both wounded and faltering.

Venom Surge.name: Venom Surge
Venom Surge.description: An intensified burst of venom that overwhelms natural resistance.

Bloodletting.name: Bloodletting
Bloodletting.description: A precise, deep cut designed to maximise blood loss.

Frostbite.name: Frostbite
Frostbite.description: A biting cold attack that slows the target's movements.

Elemental Surge.name: Elemental Surge
Elemental Surge.description: Channels raw elemental power into a searing strike, leaving the target exposed.

Consuming Darkness.name: Consuming Darkness
Consuming Darkness.description: Wraps the target in suffocating dark energy that poisons body and soul alike.

Rupture.name: Rupture
Rupture.description: Tears through armour and flesh — the wound simply refuses to close.

Soul Leech.name: Soul Leech
Soul Leech.description: Drains life essence from the target, feeding its own recovery.

Adrenaline Surge.name: Adrenaline Surge
Adrenaline Surge.description: A short, sharp rush of focus before committing to something dangerous — the surge locks the body up for a moment, though hardened reflexes soften the risk.

Overwhelming Presence.name: Overwhelming Presence
Overwhelming Presence.description: A commanding show of dominance that unnerves opponents and sharpens the mind for what's next.

Death Knell.name: Death Knell
Death Knell.description: A strike laced with dark energy — it feels like a death sentence.

Reckoning Strike.name: Reckoning Strike
Reckoning Strike.description: A calculated, decisive blow delivered the instant an opening appears.

Annihilating Blow.name: Annihilating Blow
Annihilating Blow.description: A single, devastating strike with everything behind it. The ground shakes.

Battle Trance.name: Battle Trance
Battle Trance.description: Enters a battle trance, gathering overwhelming power for two turns — but the intensity leaves it stunned and unable to act for the first of them, only unleashing the power on the second.

Undying Fury.name: Undying Fury
Undying Fury.description: Refuses to fall. A burst of raw survival instinct that heals, hardens, and enrages simultaneously — the sheer overload leaves it locked rigid for a moment before it can act on the power surging through it.

Holy Annihilation.name: Holy Annihilation
Holy Annihilation.description: An act of pure divine wrath. Those who survive rarely recover.

Quick Jab.name: Quick Jab
Quick Jab.description: A fast, low-commitment strike thrown just to keep something in the air.

Ember Flick.name: Ember Flick
Ember Flick.description: A quick flick of flame, more annoying than dangerous on its own.

Frost Nip.name: Frost Nip
Frost Nip.description: A biting nip of cold, thrown out almost reflexively.

Static Shock.name: Static Shock
Static Shock.description: A crackling discharge that leaves the target vulnerable to further damage.

Fire and Smoke.name: Fire and Smoke
Fire and Smoke.description: A flash of flames, spewing smoke and obscuring the target's vision.

Sacred Smite.name: Sacred Smite
Sacred Smite.description: A strike carrying divine condemnation, sapping the target's strength.

Shock Dart.name: Shock Dart
Shock Dart.description: A rapid dart of lightning, cheap enough to throw out again and again.

Manic Flurry.name: Manic Flurry
Manic Flurry.description: An unrelenting flurry of strikes thrown with no thought for restraint.

Enfeeble.name: Enfeeble
Enfeeble.description: Sap the target's strength, reducing their damage output.

Snarl.name: Snarl
Snarl.description: An aggressive snarl that momentarily unsettles all enemies.

Hex.name: Hex
Hex.description: A muttered ill-wish that saps the target's edge.

Expose Weakness.name: Expose Weakness
Expose Weakness.description: Identifies and exploits a gap in the target's defences.

Intimidate.name: Intimidate
Intimidate.description: An overwhelming display of ferocity that rattles all opponents.

Unsettling Gaze.name: Unsettling Gaze
Unsettling Gaze.description: A fixed, unnerving stare that leaves onlookers second-guessing their footing.

Chains of Binding.name: Chains of Binding
Chains of Binding.description: Unseen chains coil around every opponent, sapping strength and stride alike.

Curse of Frailty.name: Curse of Frailty
Curse of Frailty.description: A withering curse that strips away the target's ability to resist harm.

Scavenge.name: Scavenge
Scavenge.description: Frantically scavenges the environment, producing a crude healing salve.

Mend.name: Mend
Mend.description: A brief moment of recovery, healing minor wounds.

Rejuvenate.name: Rejuvenate
Rejuvenate.description: A small, steady trickle of restored vitality.

Blood Ritual.name: Blood Ritual
Blood Ritual.description: Performs a dark ritual, conjuring a blood potion and beginning to regenerate.

Restorative Chant.name: Restorative Chant
Restorative Chant.description: A murmured chant that knits wounds shut over a few moments.

Dark Mending.name: Dark Mending
Dark Mending.description: Draws on dark reserves to rapidly knit wounds and harden the body.

Sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
Sanctuary.description: Wards off harm while steadily restoring what was lost.

Miracle.name: Miracle
Miracle.description: An almost impossible recovery, as if fate itself intervened.

Emergency Renewal.name: Emergency Renewal
Emergency Renewal.description: A last-resort self-cast, drawing on reserves normally saved for others. Long recovery before it can be used again.

Circle of Renewal.name: Circle of Renewal
Circle of Renewal.description: A wave of restorative energy that washes over the caster and every ally alike.

Wellspring of Life.name: Wellspring of Life
Wellspring of Life.description: Calls forth a font of vitality that pours renewed life into the whole party at once.

Rallying Cry.name: Rallying Cry
Rallying Cry.description: A rousing shout that steels resolve and quickens the pace.

Banner of Wrath.name: Banner of Wrath
Banner of Wrath.description: Raises a banner that stirs a burning need to fight harder.

Guiding Light.name: Guiding Light
Guiding Light.description: A steadying aura that turns aside the worst of incoming harm.

Inspire.name: Inspire
Inspire.description: A word of encouragement that somehow eases the sting of old wounds.

Harrowing Roar.name: Harrowing Roar
Harrowing Roar.description: A soul-shaking roar that empowers the creature while demoralising all who hear it.

Battle Hymn.name: Battle Hymn
Battle Hymn.description: A powerful hymn sung mid-battle, driving everyone within earshot onward.

Unbreakable Resolve.name: Unbreakable Resolve
Unbreakable Resolve.description: A grim determination that refuses to let the body give out.

War Anthem.name: War Anthem
War Anthem.description: A final, defiant anthem that pushes body and spirit past their limits.

Guard Stance.name: Guard Stance
Guard Stance.description: Sets a firm, defensive footing, ready to absorb the next blow.

Brace.name: Brace
Brace.description: Hardens resolve and stance, reducing incoming damage briefly.

Taunt.name: Taunt
Taunt.description: A goading challenge that demands to be answered. NOTE: 'taunt' is a new mechanic not yet implemented in combat.py — this entry defines the intended data shape, forcing single-target player abilities onto this enemy while it's active.

Fortify.name: Fortify
Fortify.description: A moment spent shoring up defences and catching its breath.

Iron Bulwark.name: Iron Bulwark
Iron Bulwark.description: Becomes a living fortress, shrugging off damage and recovering steadily.

Provoke.name: Provoke
Provoke.description: A forceful challenge backed by a hardened stance, daring the target to try its luck. NOTE: relies on the same not-yet-implemented 'taunt' mechanic as Taunt.

Bulwark Wall.name: Bulwark Wall
Bulwark Wall.description: Becomes nearly immovable, shrugging off all but the heaviest blows.

Last Stand.name: Last Stand
Last Stand.description: Plants itself between the target and everyone else, daring them to get through. NOTE: relies on the same not-yet-implemented 'taunt' mechanic as Taunt.
